scope: Aggregate outputs only; no image identities, patient data, per-image predictions or annotations.
interpretation: Image and angle errors are reference-based; references are rater-mean coordinates and their angles.
Separate calibration coefficients are fitted on the same calibration subset for each condition; assessment bootstrap conditions on those coefficients.
A confidence interval containing zero is not proof of equivalence.
The shared encoder and differing objectives/training histories do not isolate tokenization necessity.
Kernel smoothing contributes to heatmap covariance.
No untouched external cohort, new clinical validation or distribution-free coverage guarantee is created.

interval_analysis_protocol.predictions: Immutable original Token50-pass coordinate means and scales; no image/model inference or training

covariance_conditions.block: Five principal2x2 landmark blocks; within-landmark x-y covariance retained; cross-landmark covariance zero
covariance_conditions.diagonal: Coordinate marginal variances only; every off-diagonal zero

interval_analysis_protocol.controlled: Same mean coordinates, marginal variances, original-pixel grid, image order, evaluation raters, and analytic Jacobian across three Token arms
interval_analysis_protocol.sampling: 4096 multivariate Gaussian draws/image, original exact RNG replay seed20260912; common standard-normal noise; Cholesky factors; original full/diagonal quantiles retained after replay verification
interval_analysis_protocol.interval: Central90% equal-tailed interval; each arm retains its own sampled midpoint and is separately rescaled
interval_analysis_protocol.calibration: Existing100 images; empirical90th percentile of abs(rater_angle-midpoint)/halfwidth, image-balanced via integer10/R weights
interval_analysis_protocol.assessment: Existing same142 images:134two-rater+8five-rater; all available rater angles averaged within image, then images equally weighted
interval_analysis_protocol.score: Proper central90% interval score: width+20*((lower-y)_+ +(y-upper)_+), degrees; lower is better
interval_analysis_protocol.bootstrap: Paired image percentile95%;2000calibration/assessment,10000all242; exact historical seed20261030 in calibration/assessment/all242 order; coefficients fixed
interval_analysis_protocol.comparison: Negative score difference favors first condition; shorter width alone does not establish better distribution estimation
interval_analysis_protocol.heatmap: Existing frozen shared Swin encoder + FPN spatial heatmaps; fitted five-block Gaussian. Practical comparator, not isolated tokenization ablation
interval_analysis_protocol.table: table_rows.csv shows only same142 raw/primary-image-balanced90% results; sensitivity modes/fullcohort preserved in long outputs

interval_analysis_limitations: 142assessment images remain internal reused-cohort observations; no newly independent cohort is created.
Conditional image bootstrap excludes calibration-coefficient uncertainty and patient clustering; no patient mapping is fabricated.
Between-pass coordinate covariance is not directly established to equal observed joint inter-rater covariance.
Coordinate covariance is manipulated post hoc with fixed predictions; the analysis does not establish architectural superiority or clinical benefit.
Native Token mixture and heatmap Gaussian use different model/training histories; compare matched metrics without interpreting the contrast as token necessity.
Exploratory paired95% intervals have no multiplicity adjustment; fixed100/142split is not a new prospective conformal guarantee.
